name: @innerspark/flint-react-tooling
description: Build and test tooling for @innerspark/flint/react. Kept out of the root package so git installs of Flint stay dependency-free.

scripts.test: node build.mjs && node test.mjs && tsc --noEmit --strict --jsx react-jsx --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target es2022 types-test/consumer.tsx index.d.ts
